Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.
I ran a speed test on my phone, but it failed and said there’s no connection. What should I do next?

Here’s what I see on my phone’s status bar:
- Airplane Mode is not enabled.
- I have excellent signal bars.
- It shows “5G” and that mobile data is enabled.
- I also noticed that Data Saver is turned on.

What should I do next?
I turned off Data Saver mode and tried running the speed test again, but it still failed and says there’s no connection. What should I try next?
I checked my SIM card status, and it shows as active and working. What should I do next?
I checked my APN settings. The APN name is set to “internet” and the MMSC URL is “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” I don’t see any errors or missing information. What should I try next?
I rebooted my phone and tried the speed test again, but it still fails and says there’s no connection. Is there anything else I can try?
###TRANSFER###
